pieces.description: A small painting on canvas of a girl in a red top climbing a tall red ladder to reach the crescent moon, with blue clouds above and a field of little flowers below, in soft pinks, greys and greens — ready to hang on a wall.

pieces.title: The Odd Squad
pieces.description: A long horizontal painting on canvas showing seven tall, thin figures in stripes and spots standing in a row against a soft green and ochre background, with a big red circle behind the middle figure — a wall piece for hanging.

pieces.title: The gossip committee
pieces.description: A small square canvas painting of a flock of round yellow chicks on long skinny legs beside a flowering plant, with real buttons glued on as the blossoms, all over a soft pale blue washed background — ready to hang on a wall.

pieces.title: Fish kisses
pieces.description: A square canvas painting of two orange and navy striped fish swimming over a pale aqua background, with blue flowers, seaweed and coral along the bottom — ready to hang as is.

pieces.title: The mushroom inspector
pieces.description: A small square canvas painting of a big-eyed green turtle sitting beside a bright red mushroom, with thin brown toadstools and a soft pale blue-green background, signed in the corner and ready to hang on a wall.

pieces.title: Hen Solo
pieces.description: A small square canvas with a stitched fabric applique bird in beige and blue floral prints, standing among hand-painted blue cornflowers on a soft pink and white washed background, ready to hang on the wall.

pieces.title: Lamaste Fabulous
pieces.description: A small square canvas painting of a party llama wearing sunglasses and a striped party hat, with fabric bunting flags glued across the top and a soft mottled green background — ready to hang on a wall.

pieces.title: Prickly but sweet
pieces.description: A square painted canvas on a soft pale green background, showing two tall flower stems with round pom-pom blooms in red, pink, teal, purple and navy, each one stitched over with thread, and a little hedgehog with a watering can at the bottom — a piece to hang on the wall.

pieces.title: Happiness on a string
pieces.description: A small square canvas painted with a soft pink and cream wash, showing a fuzzy yellow chick holding a red balloon beside a patch of flowers made from bright button-like blooms in green, orange, pink and purple — a cheerful piece for a nursery or child's room wall.

pieces.title: A little snack
pieces.description: A small square canvas painting of a friendly orange giraffe nibbling green bamboo leaves, with purple flowers to one side and a soft mottled peach background — a cheerful piece for a child's room or nursery wall.

pieces.title: Hop, hop
pieces.description: A small square canvas painted with a yellow leaping bunny with a fluffy white tail, hopping over green grass and little red flowers on a soft cream background \u2014 a sweet piece for a nursery or child's room wall.

pieces.title: Something's fishing
pieces.description: A small square canvas painting of two tropical fish "" one red and blue, one orange and black "" swimming among green seagrass with bubbles rising through a soft aqua and white water background, signed in the corner and ready to hang on a wall.

pieces.title: Sir hoots a lot
pieces.description: A small square canvas painting of a blue owl in a bowler hat, round red glasses and a bow tie, perched on a branch against a soft green background — a fun piece for a nursery or kid's room wall.
